# montecarlo_hosting_private_link (Data Source)

The VPC endpoints and private subnets Monte Carlo reaches your AWS collection agent and data store from, for limiting their policies to Monte Carlo.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance_region` (String) The region of your Monte Carlo instance to read. `primary`, the default, is the region serving your instance, which is the recovery region during a failover. `secondary` is the disaster recovery region, and only an instance with disaster recovery has one. With disaster recovery, read both and allow both, so access keeps working after a failover. During a failover both read the recovery region, so applying your policies then drops the original primary region until you apply them again after failing back.

### Read-Only

- `aws` (Attributes) AWS private connectivity. Null when the region has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws))

<a id="nestedatt--aws"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) The AWS account Monte Carlo collects from.
- `principal_arn` (String) ARN of the IAM role Monte Carlo reaches your collection agent and data store with.
- `private_subnet_cidrs` (List of String) CIDR blocks of the private subnets Monte Carlo collects from. Allow these rather than individual private IP addresses, which AWS can change.
- `regions` (Attributes List) The regions where Monte Carlo has a VPC for collection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--aws--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws.regions`

Read-Only:

- `agent_vpc_endpoint_id` (String) ID of the Lambda VPC endpoint Monte Carlo invokes a collection agent through. Use it in an `aws:SourceVpce` condition on the function's policy. Null when the region has none.
- `data_store_vpc_endpoint_id` (String) ID of the S3 VPC endpoint Monte Carlo reaches a data store's bucket through. Use it in an `aws:SourceVpce` condition on the bucket policy. Null when the region has none.
- `region` (String) The AWS region.
- `vpc_id` (String) ID of Monte Carlo's VPC in the region.
